requirements.title: Keep agent identities and credentials separate from human authority
requirements.basis: Acceptance-basis reporting is implemented: owner/self-acceptance is explicit and physical human identity remains unverified. Separate agent identities, constrained credentials and technical permission enforcement remain unmet operational capabilities; this rule is guidance-only.

requirements.title: Grant agents least-privilege, task-scoped, expiring credentials
requirements.basis: Proposed rule; no detector claimed. Candidate detection: token scope and expiry check at issuance, outside the candidate change.

requirements.title: Declare the agent's authority envelope before delegation
requirements.basis: Proposed rule; no detector claimed. Partial overlap: agent-permission changes already raise risk by path. Candidate detection: envelope reference present in the change metadata.

requirements.title: Treat content the agent reads as untrusted data, not instructions
requirements.basis: Proposed rule; no detector claimed. Runtime behaviour of the agent is not observable by metadata checks.

requirements.title: Record provenance of agent-authored changes
requirements.basis: Proposed rule; no detector claimed. Candidate detection: presence of provenance trailers or a PR metadata block. Does not verify truth.

requirements.title: Keep restricted data out of model context unless the boundary is approved
requirements.basis: Proposed rule; no detector claimed. Candidate detection: provider recorded in provenance and checked against an approved list.

requirements.title: Bound agent autonomy with budgets and stop conditions
requirements.basis: Proposed rule; no detector claimed. Limits are runtime configuration of the agent tool.

requirements.title: Never weaken verification to obtain a pass
requirements.basis: Proposed rule; no detector claimed. Partial overlap: assurance-path changes are already always high risk. Candidate detection: diff heuristics for removed assertions, added skips and weakened thresholds, reported for human review.

requirements.title: Report agent outcomes by verification state
requirements.basis: Proposed rule; no detector claimed. Candidate detection: required fields in a handoff template.

requirements.title: Record each required review in the review-record schema
requirements.basis: Detects review-record structure, supplied artifact byte hashes, subject/revision and declared role coverage. Does not authenticate reviewer origin, credentials, independence or semantic quality.

requirements.title: Declare and justify independence for agent reviewers
requirements.basis: Proposed rule; no detector claimed. Candidate detection: declared independence fields and identity inequality. Declared context sharing cannot be verified. Same-model and same-family reviewers are accepted as independent by decision; the shared-blind-spot risk remains a limitation of this control.

requirements.title: Require a defined set of reviews for every triggered change
requirements.basis: Detects review-record structure, supplied artifact byte hashes, subject/revision and declared role coverage. Does not authenticate reviewer origin, credentials, independence or semantic quality.
